name: Tesla Dynamic ACC
author: xpilot
description: Speed-based longitudinal owner, like the old DynamicAutoStock: above High the stock ACC drives, below Low SP drives, in between the current owner stays. With Tesla Traffic Light Stop (tesla_tlssc) on, the stock ACC is proposed whenever the car shows a red/yellow light or a stop line, so the car can stop for it. Optional four-finger touch on the car screen switches to the other owner and keeps that choice until the next touch or until SP disengages (set MADS to 3 or 5 fingers if both are used). Switches while engaged; the host (1 s confirm, 2 s cooldown, gas/brake/AEB/lead/acceleration vetoes) and the panda (DRAIN handoff) decide whether a switch happens. Needs SP longitudinal and the G8 panda firmware. Enable while parked, then restart.

XpTeslaDynamicAccHigh.note: km/h; stock ACC takes over above this

XpTeslaDynamicAccLow.note: km/h; SP takes over below this; must be lower than High

XpTeslaDynamicAccTouch.note: four-finger touch switches stock/SP; held until next touch or disengage
